resources.string: Modular Endfield model replacement and per-character voice routing
Install and manage third-party BEM model packages that replace in-game character assets. This module keeps its own packages and appearance settings.
Saved to the gallery; pick the image in WeChat Scan

Could not read the QR code; try again
No enhancements are enabled. Open Enhancements to turn some on.
Install and manage third-party BEM packages
Reuses the desktop model module, character presets and animation sequences. Model settings apply the next time the game starts.
Desktop presets loaded: %1$d characters, %2$d actions; 14 hook entry points compiled from the same source.
Enable logo and login ribbon theme color

Choose Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean or follow the game for each character. The character and voice-filler table comes from the desktop legacy table; the resident catalog is generated from the phone\'s own language pack the next time the game starts.
Desktop legacy table loaded: %1$d characters, %2$d character/language catalogs.
The stored voice-filler table could not be read; settings were not saved.

Changes save automatically; text saves when editing stops and refreshes when you leave the page. Configuration loads after the game is force-stopped and restarted; running actions are triggered from the overlay.
Settings saved. Force-stop and restart the game; the phone-specific catalog is generated the first time the new voice rules are used.
Model settings saved. Force-stop and restart the game.
Interface, sustained dash and camera enhancements are configured here. Actions that must fire while the game is running live in the overlay; every other switch is on this page.
Compiled from the same source as the desktop build. Hiding the UID is a persistent switch; hiding the whole HUD must be toggled in-game, so the switch is here and the trigger is in the overlay.
Hides the account UID watermark from game rendering and re-scans existing panels every 2 seconds.
Hides or restores every HUD canvas under MainHudRoot without affecting menus or settings. Toggled from the overlay button.
Free camera, world time freeze and MMD are enabled separately and triggered from the overlay while playing; the switches and values here save automatically and load after a game restart.
Invokes the game\'s own ForceClearDither to remove the translucency when the camera is close to a character. No hotkey needed.
Captures the main camera position and field of view on entry and restores them on exit. Direction and elevation keys appear when the overlay is expanded.
Freezes game time. Independent of the other features; freeze or resume from the overlay.
Hides the head with a separate mesh copy, keeping the body, arms and original shadows.
Hiding the head exposes the neck opening; a small patch covers it.
Plays a character\'s special dash action continuously. The loop segment is driven by bone pose data shipped with the module; the desktop build uses no hotkey, so this page holds every setting.
Preserves the left or right special dash chosen by the game and repeats it while sprinting, deferring natural completion. Stops on movement end or interruption.
Continues the sprint_dash_sp effect and re-ignites the 3-second highlight.
Keeps the skateboard and weapon trail, deferring the game\'s 2.2-second cleanup.
The loop segment uses bone pose data shipped with the module and the animation is driven by %1$s; the native action and movement logic stay unchanged.
Hides Reno\'s mech, including leg armor, and effects throughout her dash while keeping the flight animation.

Fixes the tail and back-hair swing and the body snap at each rewind. Rewrites about 400 bones every frame, so the per-frame cost is clearly higher than the other options; switch it off if the frame rate drops.
A draggable icon inside the game that opens the actions which otherwise need hotkeys. No system overlay permission and no background service required.
Restart the game after enabling it for the first time. The panel follows the game screen.
Inspect the panel appearance and layout locally without injecting the game.
Enhancement settings saved. Force-stop and restart the game to apply.
Matches the desktop build: the Macro Wish weapon, administrator outfit and combat sword light can each be replaced with the game\'s own ink theme, or kept as the original. Loads after a game restart.
Replace with ink sword aura and hit effects
Ink Macro Wish / unmasked form replacement
Overlay enabled. Restart the game the first time; the panel follows the game screen.
Overlay disabled. Applies after re-entering the game screen.
Better Endfield Next · import BEM / ZIP

Switches to the interface layout used for keyboard input; a keyboard and mouse or a controller is recommended. Touch buttons may disappear; disabling restores the previous input type without changing platform identity. Loads after a game restart.
Plays imported works with motion, face, camera and audio. Saves automatically and loads after a game restart; playback and status live in the in-game overlay.
MMD / advanced camera moves / import work

Choose a work folder containing set.ini and the files it references. Files are copied into the app and published so the game can read them. Imports and settings save automatically and load after a game restart; the overlay status is authoritative for playback.
Choose a work folder and import
Extra audio offset (s, -600–600, added to the work offset)
Saved automatically; loads after a game restart. Invalid text keeps the last valid value.
The work is removed from the library; a running game refreshes the library after a restart.
Plays the work\'s body motion, on by default; MMD must also be enabled. Disabling keeps the work camera and audio.
Uses the work\'s facial expressions, on by default. Playback support depends on the overlay status.
Lets body motion follow ground height, off by default; requires a usable terrain interface, and the actual capability depends on the game state.
Game mode keeps the original cloth simulation, stable mode favors stable playback and frozen mode locks the cloth; support depends on the current character.
Enable the free camera in the main settings, then start camera moves or keyframe playback from the in-game overlay. Values here save automatically and load after a game restart.
Replays the keyframe path after it reaches the end.
Keyframes are stored in the game\'s internal storage at betterendfieldnext/camera-path.becam. Saving and loading run from the in-game overlay, and the overlay status is authoritative.
